questions.q: Choose the correct question tag: “Don’t be late, ____?”
questions.why: A negative imperative takes 'will you'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “The news from the border ____ alarming.”
questions.why: 'News' is singular in form and meaning. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct phrasal verb: “Please ____ the document carefully before signing it.”
questions.why: 'Look through' means to examine. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “benevolent”:
questions.why: Benevolent means well-meaning; malevolent means wishing harm. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct article: “He is ____ honest man.”
questions.why: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound (silent h). GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive construction: “The committee will announce the results tomorrow.”
opts: The results will be announce by the committee tomorrow.
The results will announced by the committee tomorrow.
The results would be announced by the committee tomorrow.
The results will be announced by the committee tomorrow.
questions.why: Future passive: will be + past participle. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

opts: What a beautiful day, it is.
What a beautiful day it is,
What a beautiful day it is!
What a beautiful day it is?
questions.why: An exclamatory sentence ends with an exclamation mark. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the error: “Every boys in the class has a textbook.”
questions.why: 'Every' takes a singular noun: 'Every boy'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the error: “She has been studying here since three months.”
questions.why: A period takes 'for'; 'since' needs a point in time. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2026.

questions.q: Choose the meaning of the idiom “to break the ice”:
opts: to start a conversation in an awkward social situation
questions.why: 'Break the ice' means to ease initial tension among strangers. GPSC-style practice item.
